name: SEO Magic
author: Maira Foresto

sections.description:
SEO Magic adds a simple workflow to keep your on-page metadata tidy:

  • Edit title, meta description, and keywords per post.
  • Manage Open Graph / Twitter Cards fields.
  • Review and improve media library fields (title, caption, description, alt text).
  • Optional AI-assisted generation (see “External Services” below).
  • Compact admin UI focused on day-to-day SEO tasks.
    No invasive front-end code. No lock-in. Admin-only tools that store values in standard WordPress/meta fields.

External Services

This plugin can optionally use Gemini (Google AI Studio) to help draft metadata.
When you enable it by adding an API key in Settings → SEO Magic, the plugin may send the following content-derived data to the API only when you click a generate button:

  • Post/page: title, excerpt, selected content or summary, and the fields you ask to generate (e.g., meta description).
  • Image: current title/caption/alt text (if any) and surrounding post title (for context).
    It never sends WordPress usernames/passwords, email addresses, or other credentials. Usage is opt-in and can be disabled at any time by removing the API key.
    Please see:
  • Gemini / Google AI Studio Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

If you do not enable the API key, no external requests are made by this plugin.

Accessibility

Image fields encourage proper alt text. The plugin does not force HTML output;
it only stores metadata so themes/plugins can output it safely.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect personal data by default.
If you enable Gemini integration, metadata you explicitly request to generate is sent to the Gemini API.
See “External Services” for details and policies.

Developer Notes

  • Text domain: seo-magico (matches the plugin slug).
  • Use standard WordPress filters/fields; no custom tables.
  • Admin assets are enqueued via admin_enqueue_scripts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate SEO Magic.
  3. Go to SEO Magic in the admin menu to review content and media coverage.
  4. (Optional) Add your Gemini API key under Settings → SEO Magic to enable AI-assisted suggestions.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin add meta tags automatically on the front-end?

SEO Magic focuses on admin workflows and metadata management. Output depends on your theme or other SEO plugins.
You can read the saved values from post meta (e.g., _seom_… keys) and render them as you prefer.

Do I have to use the AI features?

No. They’re completely optional.
Without an API key, the plugin does not contact external services.

What does the “coverage” score mean?

A lightweight indicator (0–100) used inside the admin to show how many recommended fields are completed for a post or image.
It’s a guide, not a ranking factor.

Where are the values stored?

Standard WordPress post meta and attachment fields (e.g., _seom_title, _seom_description, _wp_attachment_image_alt for alt text).

Can I export my settings?

Yes. There’s an Export action that downloads a JSON with plugin settings only (no post content).
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fixed: review link now points to the general reviews page (no 5-star filter).
  • Fixed: sanitized/validated AJAX inputs (order, orderBy, IDs, metadata arrays).
  • Fixed: unified text domain to seo-magico and load on init.
  • UX: removed logos/SVG from admin notices to avoid layout issues.
  • Dev: minor hardening and defensive checks.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
